title: Scribble wipe
description: Hand-drawn transition: a fat, wobbly marker stroke zigzags across the frame and paints the next layer in where it passes: a highlighter band rides just behind its head (the theme's highlight) and a thin marker rim in the theme's accent2 edges it. Rows, tilt, rim, band and colours are params; deterministic, so the same transition on several tracks lines up (give the band and rim to one of them). For doodle, sketchbook and whiteboard videos.

rim.description: Width of the coloured rim, % of the frame's short side

color.description: Rim colour, a CSS colour (empty: the theme's accent2, else a marker pink)

body.description: Opacity of the marker band behind the stroke's head (0: none); on one track only when several share the cut

bodyColor.description: Band colour, a CSS colour (empty: the theme's highlight, else a marker yellow)

tail.description: Length of the band, as a share of the whole stroke
